newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut t-bill issue raises 358.6 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Beirut t-bill issue raises 358.6 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of February 13 raised 358.6 billion Lebanese pounds and the Bank of Lebanon indicated that demand was heavy for the Lebanese pound-denominated paper.
The previous issue raised 382.4 billion pounds.

The central bank said only 23 percent of all competitive bids were accepted up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills. The acceptance rate was 25 percent for six-month bills and 10 percent for 12-month and two-year bills.
